review_candidates.title: Senior Python Backend Engineer - Billing & Stripe Connect
review_candidates.description: Senior Python Backend Engineer — Stripe Connect (Freelance) Estimated duration: 10 working days Contract value: approximately $1,500 Scope: fixed project, with final deliverables agreed at kickoff Hire Africa is recruiting on behalf of a client looking for a Senior Python / Flask Backend Engineer for a short-term freelance project. You’ll build a billing and payments module using Stripe Billing/Invoicing and Stripe Connect, covering everything from invoicing brands to paying creators. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON The project involves two core billing flows: • Creator production: Invoice published and validated content at the end of a configurable billing cycle. • Platform fees: Invoice a percentage of each brand’s advertising spend every month. The client operates across multiple international markets, so the system needs to account for different currencies, VAT requirements and payment methods. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES • Integrate Stripe Billing/Invoicing and Stripe Connect • Implement mandate-based bank debits and Stripe transfers • Manage Stripe Connect accounts and KYC for billing entities • Design the data model and billing-cycle closing processes • Track payments and handle payment failures • Build reliable webhook handling • Prevent duplicate invoices and payments • Account for VAT, multiple currencies and bank debit methods across countries TECH STACK Python / Flask PostgreSQL / Supabase Stripe Billing/Invoicing + Connect The existing content pipeline and advertising-spend synchronisation are already in place. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR We’re looking for a Senior Python / Flask Backend Engineer with recent, hands-on Stripe experience. Recent experience with Stripe Billing and/or Stripe Connect is essential. You should also be comfortable with: • Data modelling • B2B billing systems • Webhooks and payment reliability • Testing and CI • Domain-driven design (DDD) HIRING PROCESS One 60–90 minute technical interview covering your previous Stripe projects, the risks you see in this project and the technical approach you would take. PRACTICAL DETAILS Contract: Freelance Estimated effort: 10 working days, subject to final scoping Start: ASAP Target delivery: September 30, 2026 Location: Remote If you have strong Python backend experience and have recently worked hands-on with Stripe Billing or Stripe Connect, we’d like to hear from you.
